prompt: Make a character sprite for my game in this image's exact art style: high resolution shaded pixel art, gritty, dark and desaturated, muted colors, same lighting and same top-down three-quarter camera angle and same character scale as the reference. It is an enemy of the undead lich's army: a champion of the holy human crusade, a direct foil to the undead. Worn, battle-scarred ivory and tarnished gold, weathered steel, off-white cloth stained with mud and soot, deep crimson trim, and soft warm holy-light glows (pale candle gold) where the undead have necrotic green; still muted and gritty enough to sit on the same dark battlefield. The character is the Dragon-Slayer, a boss: a hulking, grizzled veteran hero of the free companies in mismatched heavy plate and leather, a cloak of dull red dragon scales, a horned helm shaped like a dragon's head, wielding an enormous notched two-handed greatsword. Full body, in a wide battle stance with the greatsword ready, facing right. It is the ONLY character, standing alone in an open, empty patch of the dark battlefield ground with nothing touching or overlapping it, fully visible with clear space around it. Not a cartoon, not bright, no saturated colors.
